opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance; must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited or examined, or a Charity Commission annual return). Cannot fund individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, local authorities/councils.
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines. Support tends to be approximately 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget or project/capital costs; for local community capital projects grants are typically no greater than £30,000.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For core costs, organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over. For capital or project costs, the total cost of the project must be at least £1 million (organisation's income need not exceed £1 million). Must be a UK registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted organisation with at least one year's accounts.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £100,000 and over considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applicants submit an Expression of Interest all year round with no deadlines; reviewed on a rolling basis. If taken forward, invited to submit a full proposal for consideration at a board meeting.
